description: North Cowichan Storm Utilities is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Municipality of North Cowichan. The Storm Utilities dataset contains North Cowichan owned storm mains, fittings, manholes, services, facilities, culverts, basins, and ditches. This data may only be used under the terms of the Open Government Licence - Municipality of North Cowichan. You are encouraged to contact the data custodian if you have any questions regarding fitness for use. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Municipality of North Cowichan. Its tags are DRAINAGE, storm, storm sewer. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, FGDB, GPKG, KMZ, OTHER. The portal shows 2022-04-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Municipality of North Cowichan. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
